# RIUDICC frontend

Follow the repository-wide guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). For Angular screen implementation or visual review, use the relevant project skill under `.agents/skills/`:
- [riudicc-angular-ui](../.agents/skills/riudicc-angular-ui/SKILL.md)
- [riudicc-ui-review](../.agents/skills/riudicc-ui-review/SKILL.md)

Use the existing Angular 19, Tailwind CSS 4, DaisyUI 5, component, and theme conventions. Keep changes aligned with adjacent features and preserve backend authorization rules.
